scope: Two-photo extension: portrait; five clear ordinal comparisons plus three separately interpreted thin-boundary diagnostics; no measured ground truth or product readiness claim

photo.author: Wendelin Jacober
photo.normalization: EXIF transpose, RGB, Pillow LANCZOS longest edge1280 without upscaling; differs from product browser normalization

annotation: Independent reviewer selected image-only points before any output; coordinator reviewed geometric plausibility before freezing. Source previews1200x800. Larger raw inverse depth predicts nearer; ties are incorrect. Median of3x3 predicted-depth neighborhood; no tuning. Diagnostics are not a boundary accuracy metric.

pairs.name: subject_torso_vs_distant_town
pairs.rationale: The centrally occluding subject is much nearer than town buildings visible beyond the balcony.

pairs.name: left_door_panel_vs_town
pairs.rationale: The doorway surrounds the camera-side balcony; buildings beyond the railing are distant.

pairs.name: right_door_panel_vs_roof
pairs.rationale: Door panel is foreground architecture; roof is down and beyond the balcony.

pairs.name: balcony_floor_vs_building
pairs.rationale: Walkable floor beneath the subject is foreground; the visible building lies beyond the balcony.

pairs.name: subject_skirt_vs_background_field
pairs.rationale: Subject skirt occupies the balcony; green field is beyond its railing.

pairs.name: hair_top_vs_sky
pairs.rationale: Top hair contour against sky; sparse hairs, antialiasing, and the absence of finite sky depth make this diagnostic only.

pairs.name: left_forearm_vs_sky
pairs.rationale: Narrow arm region above the town; contour precision and arm orientation affect interpretation.

pairs.name: railing_top_vs_background
pairs.rationale: Thin horizontal railing against distant landscape; subpixel placement and mixed pixels can dominate.

baseline: Current unpainted all-subject mask ties all eight comparisons; strict score0. Manual mask/correction effort not evaluated.
